review:
Wolf Gold Ultimate updates the classic prairie slot with a much bigger respin feature. Mustangs, mountain lions and wolf wilds fill the reels, and landing six or more cash moons triggers the hold and respin bonus with three spins.

Every new cash value resets the spins to three. The key upgrade is additional grids: landing two, 11 or 25 moons unlocks a second, third and fourth respin grid, so the feature can hold up to 50 cash prizes. Mini, Minor, Major and Grand jackpots are available, and Pragmatic Play states the maximum win at 5,000x. The RTP is 96.5%. Compared with the original Wolf Gold, the bonus has much more room to grow.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
